submission.natural_language_explanation: The negative pole is a weak, graded dial for concrete physical content: it is most active on content words naming physical materials, substances, parts, body parts and small countable things (particles, cells, tissues, rocks, grains, blades, gears, valves, 'texture'; plural people and animals are intermediate) and much less active on large whole artefacts, abstract or social-institutional vocabulary (rules, costs, topics, claims, importance), proper names and function words. It is a dial rather than a crisp detector -- max activation 2.48, 83% of tokens below 0.08, token identity explains only 30% of its variance, and within-concrete vocabulary varies as much as the concrete-abstract gap -- so predict graded activity: physical/technical passages peak around 0.4-1.9, abstract/social prose around 0.1-0.4, and a strongly physical surrounding frame keeps even an abstract slot noun partly active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt:
The museum's acquisitions committee met on Thursday to review the proposed loan of a private collection, and the discussion turned first to the paperwork that would be required before any object could travel. The registrar explained that a facility report had to be filed for every venue, that the insurers would need a valuation for each item, and that the export licence would take at least six weeks to process. Counsel noted that title had to be confirmed in writing, that the lender's conditions on photography were stricter than usual, and that the loan agreement should specify which party bore the cost of packing and transport. The committee debated the schedule at length. Several members questioned whether the exhibition budget could absorb the shipping estimate, and the finance officer reminded them that the grant had been awarded on the understanding that the display would open in the spring. A subcommittee was asked to review the risk assessment, the condition report and the conservation plan and to report back before the next meeting of the trustees. The director said that the importance of the project lay in its public programme rather than in the prestige it might bring, and that the education team had already begun drafting the gallery texts and the audio guide. None of this, she added, could proceed until the legal formalities were settled and the lenders had confirmed their agreement in principle. The registrar undertook to check whether the courier's standard conditions would satisfy the lender, and the committee agreed that a revised schedule of conditions would be circulated with the minutes. The director also reported that the gallery had received a preliminary enquiry from a foreign institution about a possible exchange, though no dates had been discussed. The chair proposed that the wording of the loan agreement be revised to limit liability for damage in transit, and the treasurer agreed to obtain a second opinion on the valuation before the papers were circulated to the board.

Later, the conservators circulated their inventory of the objects themselves. There were forty-one sherds of coarse red clay, some still bearing the fingerprints of the potter; a dozen bronze fittings, green with verdigris and encrusted with grit; a handful of glass fragments, thin as leaves, whose edges had been ground smooth by the sea; and a small hoard of silver coins, each about the size of a fingernail, their faces worn almost flat. A woven fragment of wool and flax had been mounted between sheets of glass, and beside it lay several strings of tiny blue beads, a few iron nails eaten to flakes of rust, and a single carved bone pin. The conservator noted that the clay still smelled faintly of damp earth, that the bronze had begun to pit where the chlorides had not been removed, and that the glass would need controlled humidity if the flakes were not to craze.

The committee then returned to its agenda. The chair asked whether the loan fee could be waived, the treasurer queried the currency of the insurance certificate, and the secretary was instructed to circulate the minutes together with the revised timetable. The meeting closed at half past four with no decision on the schedule, and the matter was left to the next ordinary session, when the trustees would consider the recommendations of the subcommittee and any further comments from the lenders.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Concrete inventory deep in a long abstract passage, predicted active.
